It signifies the infinite and all-pervading nature of God, as acknowledged by various Hindu philosophies like Advaita and Vishishtadvaita. This name instills a sense of deep reverence, devotion, and surrender to the divine.

historical_references.reference: Onkarraj is a name mentioned in the Hindu scripture 'Satapatha Brahmana'. It is the name of a sage who is said to have performed the Ashwamedha Yajna, a horse sacrifice.
